body.statement: Identify the retained released variable by \(\ell_{23}^{\mathrm{M2}}=\beta\), the released coordinates \(s_{ij}=m_{ij}\) for \(1\le i\le j\le3\), and \(t_{ijk}=c_{ijk}\) for \(1\le i\le j\le k\le3\). For the exact pinned computation defining \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{pin}}\), division of \(R_{\mathrm{el}}=\beta W_2^{\mathrm{el}}-W_3^{\mathrm{el}}\) by the entire basis \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{pin}}\) has zero remainder.
body.justification: The pinned zero remainder is the reproducible gate connecting the independently derived linear relation to the exact released full elimination basis.
body.gap: Tramontano et al. (2025), Theorem 3.6 and its released Macaulay2 file, report the retained elimination output but do not report the normal form of this additional linear relation against the entire basis.
body.consumer: The localized degree calculation proceeds only if this exact-arithmetic checkpoint succeeds; a nonzero remainder terminates the re-audit claim.
